rules.first: No prior local event: first close > prior20 close max creates BREAK; B=frozen prior20max; a=prior20ATR; S=min prior5 lows-.25a.
rules.continuation: Consecutive highs update local peak only, never tau. At close <=peak-a enter PULLBACK_WAIT; freeze setup a=current prior20ATR and trough=low. While waiting update trough=min(trough,current low). First later close>max(previous2closes) creates PULLBACK event, B=that prior2max, S=trough-.25setup_a.
rules.failure: Test old local event before setup/confirmation: C<S OR (C<B AND A>=frozen prior20 median amount AND C<Cprev). Store failure-day high Hfail, trough=current low and a=current prior20ATR; move REPAIR_WAIT. No fixed cooldown. First later close>max(Hfail,previous2close max) creates RECLAIM, S=min lows since failure-.25failure_a. Cannot fail and recreate on same close.
rules.confirmation: For active t>tau, C>B and C>Ctau and sum signed amount aftertau>0 confirms. No five-day minimum; confirmation changes confidence, not tau or support.
rules.prestructure: Prior20 range/ATR, last5/prior15 amount ratio and higher-low flag recorded; support comes from actually observed local lows. No box-height upside target and no fixed ATR score discount.
rules.knowledge: Daily signal uses <=t only; missing day clears local knowledge and prior21 valid observations required to initialize. Earliest native e0/g-ready I_buy signal per local event is diagnostic event-entry row, not portfolio trade. Next immediate common-day observed O finite/positive and O>S permits open-price proxy; no future H/L/C/A as admission test. Missing open=UNKNOWN/no proxy, do not skip forward.
rules.risk: d=(O-S)/O, z=(O-S)/a. Probe .25R-unit and verified1R-unit are proposals only; no accounts/sizing run. At real execution supplied remaining per-name/trend/market/sector risk budget and board-lot/liquidity constraints must bind.
rules.market: All canonical contemporaneously finite stock closes: B20=share C>SMA20 includingt. Delta5 on same known-stock intersection. Regime SUPPORT B>=.5; IMPROVING B<.5 and delta>0; WEAK otherwise. Current sector labels not used in historical decisions.
rules.holding_proxy: Each event separately: after entry open evaluate closes in entryday..entry+59. First C<S OR (C<B AND A>=frozenAref AND C<Cprev) => following common-day open; T+1 respected. Otherwise terminal60close. Future missing data labelsUNKNOWN, not candidate rejection. Proxy does not override real E0/CP policy.
rules.distributions: Quarterly freeze. Only events with all60-day labels already mature strictly before freeze and start in previous3years. Cell=(BREAK/PULLBACK/RECLAIM,confirmedAtSignal,marketRegime,zbin<=2/<=4/>4). >=200 events,>=50 stocks,>=12 entrymonths or UNKNOWN. Cost50bp roundtrip sensitivity, not actual fees. Month-block 1000 bootstrap seed20261106, lower10percentile equal-month average net path returns; call conservative diagnostic score, not certified confidence bound. Tail=mean worst10percentile nonnegative loss; gap99=99percentile absolute entry gap. Rank lower-bound net return/max(individuald,tail,gap99); score<=0 not mainqueue. Unknown first/reclaim/pullback events remain separately visible exploratory candidates; they are not assigned worst score or silently counted as buys.
rules.evaluation: 37known names for logic; then all5517 earliest local-entry-event cohort, quarterly prequential development check, one top20 queue vs same-event PVR baseline, plus unknown coverage and big-event coverage. At entry open recompute z/score using only observedO; labels afterwards. No whole daily pending/portfolio return claim; all historical dates seen in prior work.
rules.falsification: No deployment if support evolves using future data, major paths require impossible fills, mature cells cover <80% intended candidates, risk-unit loss per big event fails to improve without losing >5% baseline earlybig coverage, or event-level20/60 payoff advantage disappears on year/leave-one-stock/date-block checks. A causal calculation pass is not an economic pass.
